verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not show any data export feature, open export format, or offboarding workflow for AnythingLLM. Local-first and self-hosting claims (data stays on your device, self-host with Docker) and a bare 'API Access & Keys' heading suggest ownership of data, but none of them shows that users can export all their data in open formats. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability means the verdict is none.
